title.en: Indian mortise handle set, rim nightlatch and cylindrical lock
title.zh: 印度插芯把手锁、外装夜锁与球形锁

summary.en: India is the clearest example of why a retrofit cannot be designed per country. Three incompatible interfaces share one market: a euro-profile mortise set with a 50 mm backset, a rim nightlatch with a 69 mm backset, and a cylindrical lock with a 60 mm backset. A single adapter library has to cover all three, and the backsets do not overlap.
summary.zh: 印度最清楚地说明了为什么改造方案不能按国家设计。同一个市场里并存三种互不兼容的接口：背距 50 mm 的欧标槽型插芯锁组、背距 69 mm 的外装夜锁，以及背距 60 mm 的球形锁。一套适配件库必须同时覆盖三者，而这三种背距互不重叠。

en: Mortise set: a 240 mm (9 inch) euro-profile lock body, a euro-profile pin cylinder, and a handle rose set
Rim nightlatch: a surface case with a profiled latch bolt, a rim cylinder through the door, and a knob inside
Cylindrical lock: a bored lockset, the same family as the North American A156.2 set
Commonly 5-pin brass tumbler cylinders with three keys
zh: 插芯锁组：240 mm（9 英寸）欧标槽型锁体、欧标销形锁芯，以及把手圆盖组
外装夜锁：贴面锁体带成形斜舌、穿过门扇的外装锁芯，以及内侧旋钮
球形锁：开孔式锁组，与北美 A156.2 属同一族
常见为 5 销铜弹子锁芯，配 3 把钥匙

typical.en: 50 mm on mortise handle sets, 69 mm on rim nightlatches, 60 mm on cylindrical locks
typical.zh: 插芯把手锁 50 mm，外装夜锁 69 mm，球形锁 60 mm

tolerance.en: None — the three values do not overlap, so identifying the type comes first
tolerance.zh: 无公差——三个数值互不重叠，因此先判定类型

how.en: Door edge to the centre of the keyhole or cylinder.
how.zh: 门边到钥匙孔或锁芯中心。

typical.en: 28–40 mm for mortise sets; rim nightlatches accept 25–60 mm
typical.zh: 插芯锁组 28–40 mm；外装夜锁适用 25–60 mm

tolerance.en: Wide on rim locks, narrow on mortise sets
tolerance.zh: 外装锁范围宽，插芯锁范围窄

how.en: Measure the leaf at the lock.

typical.en: Mortise lock body commonly 240 mm (9 inch) long
typical.zh: 插芯锁体常见长 240 mm（9 英寸）

how.en: Measure the strip on the door edge.

typical.en: 60 mm euro-profile cylinder supplied with most mortise sets
typical.zh: 多数插芯锁组配 60 mm 欧标槽型锁芯

how.en: Remove the central screw and measure both halves.
how.zh: 拆下中央螺钉，分别量两段。

typical.en: Euro profile on mortise sets; proprietary on many rim and cylindrical locks
typical.zh: 插芯锁组为欧标槽型；许多外装锁与球形锁为专用槽型

how.en: Compare the key blade profile against a euro profile sample.
how.zh: 将钥匙片槽型与欧标样品对比。

notes.en: The good news is that the mortise side is genuinely euro profile, so the whole European cylinder ecosystem applies — including integrated-cylinder smart locks. The bad news is that a large share of the installed base is the 69 mm rim nightlatch, where the case geometry varies and the inside control may be a knob rather than a turnable thumb-turn. Design for the rim case survey first; it is the harder half of this market.
notes.zh: 好消息是插芯一侧确实是欧标槽型，因此整个欧洲锁芯生态都适用——包括电子集成锁芯。坏消息是大量存量是背距 69 mm 的外装夜锁，其锁体几何差异大，内侧控制件可能是旋钮而非可旋转的拇指钮。应优先做外装锁体的测绘，那是这个市场里更难的一半。

en.q: Which of the three types is most common on an Indian main door?
en.a: The mortise handle set on newer and higher-spec doors, the rim nightlatch on the older installed base. Measure the backset to tell them apart: 50 mm points to mortise, 69 mm to rim.

en.q: Can a euro-cylinder smart lock fit an Indian mortise set?
en.a: Potentially yes, because the mortise set uses a euro-profile cylinder. Check the cylinder length, whether it has an emergency function, and how far it protrudes past the rose.

en.q: Is there a national Indian standard for these locks?
en.a: Not confirmed in this catalog. The dimensions recorded here come from manufacturer specifications rather than a published standard, so treat them as market practice and verify by measurement.

zh.q: 印度主门上三种类型哪种最常见？
zh.a: 较新与较高规格的门多为插芯把手锁，存量老门多为外装夜锁。量背距即可区分：50 mm 指向插芯，69 mm 指向外装。

zh.q: 欧标锁芯智能锁能装印度的插芯锁组吗？
zh.a: 有可能，因为该锁组使用欧标槽型锁芯。需确认锁芯长度、是否具备应急功能，以及它突出圆盖多少。

zh.q: 印度有这类锁的国家标准吗？
zh.a: 本目录尚未确认。这里记录的尺寸来自厂商规格而非公开标准，因此应视为市场惯例，并以实测为准。
